channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Ausar Thompson | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Ausar Thompson from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Trajan Langdon on Ausar Thompson
item.description:
Omari Sankofa II:Trajan Langdon on Ausar Thompson:

“He’s a young man and player that you want in terms of, he’s going to bring it every day, he’s going to compete every day, he’s going to work his butt off and he’s going to reach his potential. We’re very happy and excited to get an extension done.”

Trajan Langdon on Ausar Thompson, Sep 28, 2026. Source: Bluesky.

item.title: Kenny Atkinson on Ausar Thompson
item.description:
MrBuckBuck: Kenny Atkinson on the Cleveland Cavaliers' adjustments:

“The tactical adjustment we made was avoiding [Ausar] Thompson. We were just like, if he's near the ball, throw it to someone else.”

Kenny Atkinson on Ausar Thompson, May 17, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: JB Bickerstaff on Ausar Thompson
item.description:
Omari Sankofa II:Asked JB Bickerstaff about their defense on Desmond Bane:

“It’s a lot of guys, and a lot of bodies. It’s no 1-on-1 situations for him, it’s always 1-on-5s. Obviously Ausar (Thompson) has taken on a lot of that responsibility, but a lot of guys have done a great job of executing what we’re trying to do.”

JB Bickerstaff on Ausar Thompson, Apr 24, 2026. Source: Bluesky.

item.title: Jalen Brunson on Ausar Thompson
item.description:
Michael Scotto:Jalen Brunson on Ausar Thompson:

“That dude was tough to play against. He’s big-time. I told him straight to his face after the series that he made me work. I’ve got a lot of respect for him.”

Jalen Brunson on Ausar Thompson, May 2, 2025. Source: Twitter @MikeAScotto.

item.title: Monty Williams on Ausar Thompson
item.description:
Monty Williams on using Ausar Thompson more as a screen and roller:

“It’s usually out of the timeout. Now, we’re going to start to get some play calls in there to see if we can take advantage of his skillset to dive and playmake a little bit.”

Monty Williams on Ausar Thompson, Dec 10, 2023. Source: Twitter @MikeACurtis2.
